mapper.insert: INSERT INTO loyalty.outbox_event (id, tenant_id, program_id, aggregate_type, aggregate_id, event_type, payload, status) VALUES (#{id}, #{tenantId}, #{programId}, #{aggregateType}, #{aggregateId}, #{eventType}, #{payload}::jsonb, 'NEW')
mapper.select: SELECT id, tenant_id, program_id, aggregate_type, aggregate_id, event_type, payload::text AS payload, status, created_at, published_at FROM loyalty.outbox_event WHERE status = 'NEW' ORDER BY created_at, id LIMIT #{limit} FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
mapper.update: UPDATE loyalty.outbox_event SET status = 'PUBLISHED', published_at = now() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE loyalty.outbox_event SET status = 'FAILED' WHERE id = #{id}
